note: Small but worth a claim of its own: he places his own word in the wrong year and is corrected by someone in the room. The dates move in the retelling, and this is the clearest instance on camera.
Rules the bank balance out as evidence, which is the money version of symptoms-do-not-count.
Describes something already seen rather than forecasting a date, so it is closer to commentary than to a word.
An appetite for the office rather than a prediction of success, so a run satisfies it and a win is not required.
He corrects his own audience's reading, saying he did not say reptilian and is not saying it. Worth recording: the audience had run further with the image than he did.
Now conditional on prayer, which it was not before, so the absence of a scandal confirms the intercession rather than counting against the word.
Scheduling and chat. Attached to the service cadence thread; nothing claimed.

Presidential inaugurations are fixed by the Twentieth Amendment to 20 January, so the date is a day out. Recorded because the small date errors are part of the record: the Olympics opening, the State of the Union, and now this.
He asks his own team whether the Lord said anything about March 3rd. Asking rather than recalling, and looking for a March version of a February date that has now passed.

The answer confirms it was February 3rd across the record. That date has now passed and the content was never specified in any of the seven tellings. This is the moment to note it: the thread ends here without resolution.
The ark door closing soon, with soon still carrying no date after three years of the same statement.
Read off a published schedule on a website, not received. Recorded so it is never mistaken for a sighting.
Notable for what it is not: a scheduled astronomical event treated as something fun to watch rather than as a sign. Set against blood-moon-march-2025-war, where the same kind of event carried weight.
Banter and a half apology for it. Attached to the standards thread; nothing claimed.
Dated to 12 January 2026 and replayed from the original, so the telling is inside this corpus and checkable. Disruptions is not defined as political, military or economic.
The winery is a real new detail after five tellings and it narrows who is meant. He also questions whether she is a citizen, which is worth having in the record as stated.
The squad reference narrows the field considerably. Six tellings in, still not named.
The bees replayed from the 11 December original rather than paraphrased.
Chicago again, unchanged from the 1 December telling.
A prayer for character rather than an outcome, unlike vance-2028-realignment which is a sight.
Dates the chariots to 25 December 2024 with the gifts being handed out, which puts the original telling inside this corpus.

The withholding rule again, now as something he says he is still learning: not everything seen is to be said, and he must discern faster. An unpublished sight cannot be scored, which is why this keeps mattering.
A book recommendation from the same tradition, the author not named in the passage, so the link is marked unsure.
About adults with special needs being left out, which in context is about his own household.
Third on-air replay of a raw original in six weeks, after the ice storm and the California word. That practice is the single most useful thing he does for anyone checking his record.
He is anonymous, so nothing can be matched to him and the claim cannot resolve either way.

Fourth consistent telling of the same call, now with the prayer clause attached. That is a real change: a Republican hold would previously have falsified it, and now it confirms the intercession instead.
